summary: Orient Technologies Ltd board approved amendments to its Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI on October 19, 2026, effective immediately.

headline: Aartech subsidiary signs MoU with Shenzhen Titan for energy storage
summary: Faradigm Ultracapacitors, a wholly owned subsidiary of Aartech Solonics, signed an MoU with Shenzhen Titan Smart Energy to explore LFP battery manufacturing in India.

headline: Nuvama Asset Management gets SEBI nod for SIF launch
summary: Nuvama Asset Management Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Nuvama Wealth Management, has received SEBI approval to establish a Specialized Investment Fund under SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 2026.

headline: Ontic Finserve Q2FY27 Results: Zero Revenue, Losses Widen
summary: Ontic Finserve reported zero revenue for Q2FY27. The company posted a net loss of ₹4.20 lakh, driven by other expenses and lack of operational income.

headline: Flora Corp to meet on fund raising plans
summary: Flora Corporation Limited scheduled a board meeting for October 23, 2026, to evaluate proposals for raising funds through equity shares or convertible warrants.

headline: Indiqube Spaces approves ₹35 crore investment in SaiEdge Realty
summary: Indiqube Spaces board approves up to ₹35 crore investment in SaiEdge Realty for commercial office development. Director changes and committee reconstitution also announced.

headline: Omkar Speciality approves sale of two plots
summary: Omkar Speciality Chemicals board approved the sale of two industrial plots in Badlapur, totaling 8,393 sq. mtrs. The decision was taken at a meeting on October 19, 2026.

headline: Triveni Engineering faces ₹22.92 lakh GST penalty
summary: Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd received a penalty of ₹22.92 lakh from CGST Shamli for invoice violations in FY21-22. The company plans to appeal the order.

headline: Aris International board to consider share split
summary: Aris International Limited's board will meet on October 22, 2026, to discuss the sub-division of equity shares with a face value of ₹10 each.

headline: Bansal Wire confirms 1:5 share split credit
summary: Bansal Wire Industries confirmed the credit of sub-divided shares under new ISIN. The 1:5 split increased outstanding equity shares to 78.27 crore while keeping paid-up capital unchanged at ₹78.27 crore.

headline: PI Industries incorporates PI Foundation as WOS
summary: PI Industries Limited has incorporated PI Foundation, a wholly owned subsidiary under Section 8 of the Companies Act, to manage CSR activities. The entity was registered in Udaipur on October 19, 2026.

summary: SML Mahindra updated its Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI effective October 19, 2026, complying with SEBI insider trading regulations.

headline: Athena Constructions certifies no related party transactions
summary: Athena Constructions Ltd submitted a certificate to BSE confirming the non-applicability of related party transaction disclosures for H1FY27, citing no qualifying transactions under SEBI regulations.

headline: Shalibhadra Finance CS resigns
summary: Shalibhadra Finance Ltd submitted the resignation letter of Megha Singh as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 1, 2026.

headline: Nexjuris resigns as Reganto internal auditor
summary: Reganto Enterprises Limited announced the resignation of internal auditor Nexjuris Partners LLP due to professional commitments. The cessation is effective October 19, 2026.

headline: Oxford Industries completes open offer, reclassifies promoters
summary: Oxford Industries Ltd completed the open offer by Saroj Kumar Choudhury on September 18, 2026. Eight former promoter group members have been reclassified as public shareholders under SEBI regulations.

headline: Kaya gets BSE, NSE nod for ₹50 crore preferential issue
summary: Kaya Limited received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for a preferential issue of 18.24 lakh shares at ₹274.10 each to Axana Estates and Plutus Investments.

headline: Rose Merc appoints new ED, plans payment aggregator
summary: Rose Merc Limited appointed Ms. Niti Trivedi as Executive Director and applied for a Payment Aggregator license. The board also reconstituted several key committees.

headline: Transrail Lighting to acquire 49% stake in solar SPV
summary: Transrail Lighting approved acquiring 49% equity in NOPL Pace Green Energy for up to ₹20 crore. The target holds a 990 MW solar portfolio under PM-KUSUM.

headline: Diamond Power appoints Kundip Thakker as CFO
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd has appointed Kundip Thakker as Chief Financial Officer and KMP effective October 20, 2026. He succeeds Lohiya, who is re-designated as Deputy CFO.

headline: Seshachal approves ₹41.8 lakh preferential issue
summary: Seshachal Technologies approved a preferential allotment of 55,000 shares at ₹76 each and a ₹10 crore investment in Triveni Jewellers.

headline: Alembic Pharma sets up UAE subsidiary
summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals has incorporated Alvesta Pharmaceuticals FZCO in Dubai via a wholly owned subsidiary to distribute its pharmaceutical products.

headline: Manorama Industries approves Dr. Rohini Tiwari as Independent Director
summary: Manorama Industries Limited shareholders approved the appointment of Dr. Rohini Tiwari as Non-Executive Independent Director via postal ballot with 99.9994% votes in favor.

headline: Mega Fin AGM notice for FY26 results
summary: Mega Fin (India) Ltd convenes 44th AGM on Nov 14, 2026, to adopt FY26 financials, reappoint Ajay S Mittal, and appoint new auditors.

headline: Interactive Financial board meets Oct 23 for rights issue
summary: Interactive Financial Services Ltd will hold a board meeting on October 23, 2026, to finalize rights issue terms. The agenda includes determining the issue price and entitlement ratio.

headline: ACS Technologies gets BSE listing nod for preferential shares
summary: ACS Technologies Ltd received listing approval from BSE for 49,50,495 equity shares issued on a preferential basis. The shares were allotted to non-promoters via loan conversion.

headline: IREDA Q2FY27 Net Profit Rises 1% YoY to ₹554 Crore
summary: IREDA reported a standalone net profit of ₹554.26 crore for Q2FY27, up 1% YoY. Total income rose 14% YoY to ₹2,344.75 crore, driven by higher interest income.

headline: Clio Infotech to acquire 100% stake in UK subsidiary
summary: Clio Infotech's board approved an investment of £1000 to subscribe to 1000 equity shares of Clio Quantinfra Limited (UK), making it a wholly owned subsidiary.

headline: IIRM Holdings gets NSE listing approval
summary: IIRM Holdings India Ltd received NSE approval for listing its equity shares effective October 22, 2026. The move expands trading access for the company's 6.97 crore shares.

headline: Gabriel India forms JV with Faurecia Anand Seating
summary: Gabriel India has formed a joint venture with Faurecia Anand Seating, holding 50% minus one share in the newly established venture.

headline: Charms Industries board meets Oct 23 for capital raise
summary: Charms Industries Limited will hold a board meeting on October 23, 2026, to consider increasing authorised share capital and raising funds via equity or warrants.

headline: TCI reschedules Q2FY27 investor call to Oct 30
summary: Transport Corporation of India Limited has rescheduled its analyst and investor conference call for Q2FY27 results to October 30, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST.

headline: HFCL hosts analyst call recording on website
summary: HFCL Limited hosted the audio recording of its October 19, 2026 investor call on its official website. The disclosure was made under SEBI Listing Regulations for stakeholder information.

headline: JSW Dulux receives ₹42 Cr GST demand order
summary: JSW Dulux received a GST demand of ₹42.04 crore from Karnataka authorities for FY21 ITC disallowance, down from the initial show cause notice amount.

headline: ISCITRUST sponsor holding at 86.88% in Q2FY27
summary: Sponsor group holds 86.88% of units in Intelligent Supply Chain Infrastructure Trust for Q2FY27, with zero pledged units.

headline: Digital Fibre Infra Trust sponsor holding at 48.985%
summary: Digital Fibre Infrastructure Trust reports sponsor group holding of 48.985% as on September 30, 2026. Public holding stands at 51.015%, with zero pledged units.

headline: Federal Bank holds virtual investor meet with HSBC
summary: Federal Bank held a one-on-one virtual meeting with HSBC Securities on October 19, 2026. No presentations were made during the session.

headline: Soni Medicare board to review hospital O&M agreement
summary: Soni Medicare Ltd will hold a board meeting on October 26, 2026, to consider a framework agreement for the operations and management of Soni Hospital.

headline: Jaiprakash Power Q2 net profit falls to ₹333 crore
summary: Jaiprakash Power Ventures reported a sharp decline in Q2 net profit to ₹333 crore from ₹1.8 billion YoY, despite revenue growth. EBITDA margins contracted significantly.

headline: NBCC appoints Ashutosh Gautam as Director (Projects)
summary: NBCC (India) Limited has appointed Ashutosh Gautam as Director (Projects) effective October 19, 2026. Gautam, formerly of RVNL, brings over 34 years of infrastructure experience.

headline: Bajaj Finance re-appoints Prashant Verma as CISO
summary: Bajaj Finance Ltd has re-appointed Prashant Verma as Chief Information Security Officer effective February 1, 2027. The appointment is for a three-year term, subject to regulatory approvals.

headline: Shri Niwas Leasing reports nil related party transactions
summary: Shri Niwas Leasing and Finance Limited disclosed no related party transactions for Q2 and H1 FY27. The filing confirms zero value in loans, advances, or investments during the period.

headline: Just Dial Q2 net profit falls 9% YoY to ₹1.08 billion
summary: Just Dial reported a 9% YoY decline in standalone net profit to ₹1.08 billion, missing estimates. Revenue rose 13% to ₹3.43 billion, but EBITDA margin contracted to 26.43%.

headline: DeltaCorp Q2 net loss widens to ₹1 billion
summary: DeltaCorp reported a consolidated net loss of ₹1 billion in Q2, swinging from a profit of ₹251 million YoY. Revenue fell to ₹1.6 billion from ₹1.83 billion.

headline: Elevate Campuses Q1FY27 Results: Revenue up 31% YoY
summary: Elevate Campuses reported consolidated revenue of ₹2,191.35 million for Q1FY27, a 31% YoY rise. Net profit stood at ₹340.58 million, down from prior year's exceptional gains.

headline: Saraswati Saree Depot faces ₹32 lakh GST penalty
summary: CGST Kolhapur imposed a ₹32.09 lakh penalty on Saraswati Saree Depot for inadmissible ITC on IPO expenses. The company plans to contest the order in higher appellate forums.

headline: Karnataka Bank COO Raja B S resigns
summary: Raja B S, Chief Operating Officer of Karnataka Bank Ltd, resigned effective October 19, 2026, after 37 years to pursue other career interests.

headline: Ircon gets NSE waiver for compliance delays
summary: Ircon International received a waiver of fines from NSE for delays in SEBI LODR compliance for quarters ending Dec 2024 to Sep 2026.

headline: Systematic Industries to acquire Wire Brigade
summary: Systematic Industries enters SPA to acquire 100% equity of Wire Brigade Industries from Veritas Industries. Deal valued at ₹21.50 crore via cash and share swap.

headline: Kalyani Cast Tech to host business update call on Oct 29
summary: Kalyani Cast Tech Limited will hold a business update conference call on October 29, 2026, at 12:00 pm IST. Investors can join via pre-registration or dial-in.

headline: Aerpace Industries Q2FY27 Results: Loss widens to ₹551 lakh
summary: Aerpace Industries reported a widened net loss of ₹551 lakh for Q2FY27. Board approved variation in preferential issue objects, reallocating ₹30 crore for capex and debt repayment.

headline: Sterling & Wilson subsidiary sues insurers for ₹25.50 crore
summary: Sterling & Wilson Renewable Energy's step-down subsidiary SWEPL filed litigation in South Africa against insurers for ₹25.50 crore after bond invocations failed.

headline: Rallis India to meet institutional investors in Singapore
summary: Rallis India Ltd will hold one-on-one meetings with Oxbow Capital, Invisage Capital, Eastspring Investments, and Morgan Stanley Asset Management in Singapore from October 26-29, 2026.

headline: GOCL Q2FY27 Net Profit Rises 189% YoY
summary: GOCL Corporation reported a consolidated net profit of ₹40.50 crore for Q2FY27, up 189% YoY. The board also noted an NCLT order for the proposed merger with Hinduja National Power Corporation.

headline: Lords Mark to raise ₹100 crore from promoter
summary: Lords Mark Industries board meets Oct 23, 2026, to approve ₹100 crore unsecured loan from promoter Sachidanand Upadhyay with equity conversion option.

headline: Swaraj Suiting issues corrigendum to EGM notice
summary: Swaraj Suiting Limited issued a corrigendum to its EGM notice for October 24, 2026. The amendment clarifies fund utilization details for a ₹117.25 crore equity issue and a ₹56.95 crore warrant issue.

headline: Max Healthcare approves PRSU scheme, MoA changes
summary: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd shareholders approved a new PRSU scheme covering 73.5 lakh shares and expanded its Memorandum of Association to include medical education and pharma manufacturing.

headline: NSE waives Shah Metacorp fine
summary: NSE has approved the waiver of a ₹2,360 fine levied on Shah Metacorp for a one-day delay in filing shareholding pattern for Q1FY27.

headline: IRCTC Suresh Kumar Sharma ceases as SMP
summary: IRCTC announced the cessation of Suresh Kumar Sharma as Senior Management Personnel effective October 19, 2026. He was repatriated prematurely on his own request.

headline: Fabino Enterprises promoter group reclassified to public
summary: Fabino Enterprises Ltd reclassified its former promoters to public category and acquirers R G Family Trust, Sameer Gupta, and Sundeep Gupta to promoter group following an open offer.

headline: Quint Digital Q2FY27: Standalone loss widens to ₹651 lakh
summary: Quint Digital reported a standalone net loss of ₹651.40 lakh in Q2FY27, driven by a sharp rise in finance costs and depreciation. Consolidated revenue grew 371% YoY to ₹3,678 lakh.

headline: Shiva Granito adds EGM item for new director
summary: Shiva Granito Export Ltd issued an addendum to its November 2026 EGM notice, adding a special resolution for the appointment of Rekha Panwar as an independent director.

headline: Niva Bupa director Roger Davis passes away
summary: Niva Bupa Health Insurance announced the demise of Non-Executive Director Roger William John Davis on October 17, 2026. He also ceased to be a member of the Risk Management Committee.

headline: Varmora Granito Q2FY27 Net Profit Up 37% YoY
summary: Varmora Granito reported a 37% YoY rise in standalone net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue grew 17% YoY to ₹3,871 crore, driven by strong operational performance.

headline: SIS Ltd President Vineet Toshniwal resigns
summary: SIS Limited announced the resignation of Vineet Toshniwal, President of M&A and Investor Relations, effective January 31, 2027. The departure is due to personal reasons.

headline: Varmora Granito Q1FY27 Results
summary: Varmora Granito posts ₹147.18 million standalone net profit in Q1FY27, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue rose 3.6% YoY to ₹2,962.91 million.

headline: Quick Heal CS Sarang Deshpande resigns
summary: Quick Heal Technologies Company Secretary Sarang Deshpande resigned for personal reasons. His last working day is on or before October 27, 2026.

headline: Gallantt Ispat Q2FY27 PAT falls 31% YoY
summary: Gallantt Ispat reported a consolidated net profit of ₹6,051 lakh for Q2FY27, down 31% YoY. Revenue rose 13% to ₹1.14 lakh crore, but margins compressed due to higher raw material costs.

headline: Transworld Shipping signs MOA for $16.5M vessel
summary: Transworld Shipping Lines signed a Memorandum of Agreement to acquire the vessel SALTWIND EXPLORER for US$ 16.5 million from Saltwind Explorer Inc.
